facts.text: Environment-level telemetry and app-level telemetry can be enabled separately to Application Insights resources.
Per-extension telemetry enabled from Business Central 2020 release wave 2 by setting connection string in app.json.
Both online and on-premises instances can emit telemetry to Application Insights.
Telemetry data is stored in Application Insights Logs in traces and pageViews tables, queried with KQL.
Two free, open-source Power BI apps available from marketplace: one for environment telemetry, one for app telemetry.
Power BI Pro licenses required to install telemetry Power BI apps.
